subject: Admin role-change audit export & retention - options and delivery
messages:

Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:07:12 -0700
Subject: Request: admin role-change audit export and retention details

Hi Sofia,

We need a formal export of admin account role-change events for a scoped compliance review. Scope: 2027-01-01 -> 2027-06-30. Specifically we need:
- All actions that assign, modify, or revoke admin roles (including via SSO/SCIM).
- Identity of actor and target account (we can accept salted hash of user email if you cannot provide PII).
- Before/after role set, timestamp, request method (console/API/SCIM/sync), IP address, and request ID.
- Related service account key rotations and API token creations/deletions.

Questions: preferred format (CSV/NDJSON/Parquet), recommended retention window, redaction options for personal identifiers, delivery options (S3 with presigned link vs encrypted bundle). Also please include a manifest describing fields and checksums.

Thanks,
Maya R. (Greenline Audit Team)
[Greenline Health Compliance]

From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: audits+redwood@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:28:45 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: admin role-change audit export and retention details

Team — forwarding Greenline's ask. Quick proposal below for what we can deliver and trade-offs. Please reply with any constraints or pushbacks.

What we log (short):
- auth: interactive console logins, SSO assertions, token-based API auth events (timestamp, principal, login_method).
- admin_activity: role grants/revokes, permission point-changes, role definition edits, delegation/impersonation events.
- service_credentials: service-account key create/delete/rotate, API key create/delete/expire.
- iam_sync: SCIM user provisioning events and mapped attribute diffs.
- request_meta: IP, user-agent, request_id, region, and trace_id if available.

Export options (we can produce):
1) Snapshot CSV per event type + manifest (easy review, human readable).
2) NDJSON stream (line-delimited JSON) with gzip + Parquet for analytics on request.
3) Delta export: compressed archive of changes since a given anchor (useful for large windows).

PII handling: we can supply plain email/uid, or deterministic salted SHA256(email) with salt provided to Greenline for one-time mapping, or HMAC with customer-managed key (KMS).

Redaction: full-email redaction, IP truncation (/24), or pseudonymization (hash + rotating salt). Note: truncation reduces forensic fidelity for IP-based investigation.

Delivery: presigned S3 (7-day), AES-256-GCM encrypted tarball with password delivered via 2FA, or direct SFTP transfer to your audit appliance. We provide file-level SHA256 checksums and an overall manifest.

Retention guidance: default admin_activity retention is 24 months in hot storage; we can produce an export beyond that from cold archives for up to 5 years on request (additional lead time for retrieval).

Next steps: Markus — can you outline the export schema and estimated runtime for a 6-month snapshot? Priyom — confirm redaction scripts and whether HMAC with customer KMS is available. Lauren — please prepare the delivery options and ACL checklist for S3/sftp. I'll draft the external response once we have the details.

Sofia
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:05:02 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: admin role-change audit export and retention details

Quick tech notes from infra:
- Schema: event_id,timestamp,actor_type,actor_id_hash,actor_display,action,resource_type,resource_id_hash,resource_display,prior_roles,post_roles,method,request_id,ip,ua,region,trace_id
- actor_id_hash/resource_id_hash will be SHA256(email + customer_salt) by default. We can HMAC-SHA256 using a customer KMS key if they provide access (best for reversible mapping on their side).
- Size estimate: ~4.2M events for 6 months for Greenline (based on their tenant activity). Exports: NDJSON gz ~ 1.2GB; Parquet ~ 320MB.
- Runtime: full snapshot generation on a non-urgent priority queue ~ 2 hours; urgent queue (paid expedited job) ~ 30 minutes but impacts other jobs.
- Checksums: per-file SHA256 (we'll include a signed manifest). We also support chunked uploads at 5GB per part.
- Redaction script: PR attached (redaction_guidelines.md). It performs: optional email hashing, optional IP truncation, optional removal of user_display_name. We log redaction metadata in a separate file so auditors can verify which transformations were applied.

Attachments: role_change_manifest.csv (sample header), redaction_guidelines.md (rules + example), s3_transfer_instructions.txt (ACL and lifecycle notes).

Markus
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: admin role-change audit export and retention details

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the clear scope. We can deliver the 2027-01-01 -> 2027-06-30 role-change export with the following agreed options:
- Format: NDJSON gz (primary) + Parquet for analytics.
- Identifiers: SHA256(email + customer_salt) by default. If Greenline wants reversible HMAC, we can HMAC with a customer-managed KMS key — please confirm.
- Redaction: we will pseudonymize emails and provide IP truncated to /24 unless you request full IPs in a secure-delivery mode.
- Delivery: presigned S3 link (7-day) + signed manifest including per-file SHA256; we can alternatively provide an AES-256-GCM encrypted tarball via SFTP.
- Retention note: data is retained 24 months in hot storage; we performed the export from hot storage and included a checksum manifest (see attachments). Cold-archive pulls may add lead time.

Attachments included: role_change_manifest.csv (field descriptions + sample rows), redaction_guidelines.md (what was redacted/pseudonymized), s3_transfer_instructions.txt (ACL and lifecycle settings we've applied).

If this works, please confirm whether we should: 1) proceed with default salted SHA256; 2) proceed with customer KMS HMAC (please provide KMS ARN); or 3) provide PII in encrypted bundle (requires additional approvals). Also confirm preferred delivery method.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
